steps.title: Present Simple · negative
steps.html:
PersonNegativeExample
I / You / We / Theydon't + base verbThey don't have free time.
He / She / Itdoesn't + base verbHe doesn't work at night.
with to beam not / isn't / aren'tShe isn't busy.

don't = do not. doesn't = does not.

After doesn't the verb has no -s: he doesn't work, not he doesn't works.

to be does not use don't: say she isn't busy, not she doesn't be busy.

steps.title: at, in, on with time
steps.html:
PrepositionUse it withExample
atclock times, midday, midnight, nightat half past six, at night
inthe morning, the afternoon, the evening, months, yearsin the morning, in July
ondays and dateson Monday, on 3 May

at night is the exception — not in the night.
